metadata.title: Two Degrees: complete batch journeys
metadata.source: Synthetic, compressed teaching scenarios. All businesses, assets and people are fictional.
metadata.threshold_note: 2–6 °C is an illustrative chilled-stage range, not a regulatory limit or safety certification. Milking and initial cooling have no static chilled-stage limit.
metadata.timing_note: The two-hour journey and initial cooling curve are compressed demonstration timelines, not validated dairy process specifications.
metadata.batch_integrity_note: Each batch keeps its identity and quantity through every stage. No mixing, splitting or processing is simulated.
metadata.event_note: scenario_events are scheduled simulator events. Reveal only when their timestamp is reached; they are not staff action records or inferred diagnoses.

batches.route_name: Cedar Meadow farm to East Gate receiving hub

stages.name: Milking
stages.description: Fresh milk collected before cooling. Warm readings are expected in this illustrative stage.

stages.name: Initial cooling
stages.description: Milk temperature decreases progressively. Check the demo cooling target at stage completion.

cooling_target.description: Illustrative endpoint target. Do not apply a 6 °C ceiling to the entire cooling curve.

stages.name: Farm storage
stages.description: Cooled milk remains in the farm bulk tank before collection.

stages.name: Tanker loading
stages.description: The same batch is transferred through a closed hose into the assigned tanker.

stages.name: Transport
stages.description: Monitor the assigned tanker during the journey to the receiving dairy hub.

stages.name: Delivery storage
stages.description: Received batch enters chilled storage. Incident review and release remain separate decisions.
